text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I passed by the outdoor stage, lively 
voices caught my ear.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, carry that mikoshi 
right, ya hear! If you're Umamusume, show 
'em that true Edokko spirit!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You think carrying it all half-hearted 
like that makes you the highlight of the 
festival? Move those legs in time with the 
chant, get to it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm, something's just not working 
right... Like my hips aren't in it, or it 
lacks momentum.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer! Hold on a second. Mind 
hearin' me out on a little advice?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I ended up having to carry the portable 
shrine for a shopping district event, but 
I just can't seem to make it look right.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Like this, the spirit of Edo won't come 
through at all. What do you think is 
missin', pal?
choice_data_list: Is it because there are no spectators?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Dy-na-mism... I see... Guess if you're 
just mincing around in cramped spots, you 
can't get into the groove, huh.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, you lot... and you over there, 
Trainer, follow me! Time to hit the 
streets!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parading all over the academy, we 
finally ended up right at the uphill 
course!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Look at that, you're really gettin' the 
hang of it! Let's hit the peak and call it 
a day!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Even so, this hill really is brutal, huh. 
Alright, I'll lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wait, gah, dammit, my shoulder can't reach 
the carrying pole!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Daaamn it, if only I were taller! No, if I 
stand on tiptoes... I can just barely 
reach...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With tiny yet powerful Inari One calling 
the cadence, the portable shrine reached 
the top of the hill.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that having spectators around, 
just like in an actual race, would make 
for great practice.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I see, the crowd, huh. Well yeah, when 
cheers rain down from the stands, it 
really puts wind in your sails.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
In that case... I'm counting on you, 
Trainer! Give me a real fired-up cheer to 
get my blood pumping!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Come on, chant with me! Heave-ho! 
Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Not yet, keep pushing for more!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I can feel the power surging 
through me! Come on, shout eveeeen louder 
from your gut—!
